p: last sons of Adonikam: That came to go with Ezra.
river that runneth to Ahava: To that place of Euphrates, where the Ahava river enters it.
chief at the place Casiphia: He was the chief teacher of the law to the Levites.
ourselves before our God: He shows that the purpose of fasting is to humble the body to the spirit, which must proceed from the heart that is touched, or else it is hypocrisy.
ashamed to require of the king: He thought it better to commit himself to the protection of God, than by seeking these ordinary means to give others a reason to think that he doubted God's power.
wait by the way: This declared that their journey was full of danger and yet God delivered them according to their prayer.
Levites: This was a token of a good conscience and of his integrity that he would have witnesses of his fidelity.
